title: Hierarchical Organization
coreMove: Build layers that preserve coordination at scale without smothering local judgment.
sourcePressure: Hierarchical Organization concerns nested levels, role layers, scale, and coordination through structure.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: assuming hierarchy is either always oppressive or always efficient

hook: opening with a definition of Hierarchical Organization
counterintuition: assuming hierarchy is either always oppressive or always efficient
